test_title: SSC MTS Previous Year Paper (Held on: 22 July 2022 Shift 2)
subject: general
question:
Select the most appropriate synonym of the given word.

Voracious
solution:
The correct answer is **Greedy.**

** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__**

__
 
• The most appropriate synonym of the given word is Greedy.
 
• The given word is **Voracious**. Its meaning is** ****a strong desire for or appetite for food.**
 
• Thus the correct word is** Greedy.​**

** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] Additional Information__**

__
 
• **Restrained -** It means** exhibiting restraint or moderation **
 
• **Moderate - **It means** average in size.**** **__
 
• **Truthful -** It means** communicating or speaking the truth.**
